about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-04 at about 1-2% over the measured size.
